segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the team package for the three plant sites and make sure the seat count and invoice timing line up before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 28 users today, but Greenville needs 6 more for the second shift. So call it 34 seats starting April 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 34 seats effective April 15. The annual rate on the pricing sheet is $188 per seat per month, billed annually, so the first invoice would be $76,704 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Can you split that by site on the invoice? Finance wants Greenville, Dayton, and Mesa broken out, even if it’s one contract.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can list the sites as separate line items on the invoice. Same payment terms as your current agreement, net 30, and it’ll still be one subscription.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. The other thing is implementation. We need Greenville live by May 20 because the audit starts June 3.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s reasonable. If we have signature by April 12, onboarding can start April 16. Training would be two admin sessions and one operator session, all remote, and go-live targeted for May 17.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Are the training sessions included, or is that extra?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included for the 34-seat annual package. If you want onsite later, that would be quoted separately, but the remote training and setup are included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the order form to me and cc procurement. They’ll need the PO number on the invoice; it’s PO-45821.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the April 15 start date, 34 seats, annual billing, site-level invoice lines, and PO-45821 noted.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If the numbers match what you just said, I can sign tomorrow.
